title: Pin the late bound-check and flagged post-cut move/revert evaluation boundaries with regressions
outcome: Pin the late bound-check and flagged post-cut move/revert evaluation boundaries with regressions
acceptance: A regression declares the judged source, takes the evaluated cut before a later passed host verification for a bound criterion, and proves the declared passed-check exemption allows movement scanning but the citation is refused as beyond the evidence basis
A regression evaluates revision A, records flagged source changes to B and back to A after its cut, and proves the original evaluation remains void despite the equal final revision
The changeset is test-only and retains current runtime behavior; both exact transitions pass through the required full gate and independent review

completion.summary: Two regressions pin acceptance-evaluation boundaries the lifecycle brief had reached by reasoning only. (1) same_turn.rs: a bound criterion's only passed check, after the cut on the declared revision, is exempt from the movement scan, but citing it is refused as beyond the evidence basis; a cut including it records. (2) basis_moves.rs: a flagged A->B->A after the cut, declared or not, in one or two turns, leaves the evaluation void, with the change to B as the deciding observation. The lifecycle brief's coverage paragraph names them (prose change authorized by Engram::Fable, #484). No runtime change. Landed bf1d4454, full gate test-f11a791d 9/9, round 1 clean, independent evaluation passed 3/3.
